accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: On average, hostels in Prague cost around $12 per dorm bed and $100 per private room per night. Hostelz.com Price Comparison.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Hostelz city comparison result crawled 3 weeks before retrieval (July 2026); city-level average, source period otherwise not stated
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: site:hostelz.com Prague hostel dorm bed average nightly price Hostelz
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.reason: The Hostelz result identifies Prague and gives an explicit city-level average for one dorm bed per night in USD. It is a one-adult bed observation; no two-traveller scaling was performed.

accom_hostel_private_room.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Prague hostel dorm private room average nightly price
accom_hostel_private_room.reason: The two targeted searches returned city-level private-room prices ($100 from Hostelz and $26 from Budget Your Trip), but neither source explicitly establishes two-adult or two-guest occupancy. The private-room measure therefore fails closed; no value is substituted.
